pattern: WAI-ARIA toggle buttons (button with aria-pressed) in a named group, with roving tabindex as in the APG toolbar pattern.

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the group (to the last focused button) and out of it.
Move to the next or previous enabled button (reading direction aware, wraps).
Move to the next or previous enabled button (wraps).
Move to the first or last enabled button.

focus: One button in the tab sequence (roving tabindex); clicking a button makes it the tab stop.
notes: The pressed state differs in more than hue (selection fill and a stronger boundary) and is exposed with aria-pressed.
Required single groups keep one button pressed; pressing it again does nothing.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
